What sins can and cannot be forgiven?

Earlier this year, the organization Americans Who Tell the Truth (AWTT)
[announced](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/portraits/noam-chomsky/),
“Taking Down Noam Chomsky’s Portrait,” literally canceling Noam Chomsky from
[its portrait gallery](https://americanswhotellthetruth.org/portrait-
gallery/). This is no surprise. It is a surprise that AWTT deems Dwight
Eisenhower’s CIA coup-approval sins to be forgivable, and he remains worthy of
an AWTT portrait. Furthermore, AWTT inconsistently applies its “Chomsky
cancellation criteria” by continuing to display portraits of Malcolm X,
Muhammad Ali, and Mark Twain; and AWTT gives the Left’s harshest indicter of
Chomsky, Chris Hedges, a pass for his very different sins, and his portrait
remains.

AWTT is a nonprofit organization founded in the wake of the Bush/Cheney
administration’s lies about the reasons for attacking Iraq. AWTT’s website
states that “The organization is dedicated to promoting civic engagement,
social justice, democracy, and environmental stewardship” and its “portraits
and narratives highlight citizens who courageously address issues of social,
environmental, and economic fairness.”

Earlier in 2026 in _CounterPunch_ , I detailed Noam Chomsky’s personal
failings with regards to sexual predator Jeffrey Epstein (“[Malcolm X, Noam
Chomsky, Sexual Predator Associations, and Legacy
Twists](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/04/10/malcolm-x-noam-chomsky-sexual-
predator-associations-and-legacy-twists/)”), and I will return to what is fact
versus conjecture. But even the most damning speculation about Chomsky’s state
of mind does not rise to the disgracefully damaging orchestrations and actions
by Eisenhower, whose portrait AWTT maintains.

Apparently, Eisenhower gets his portrait because of one truth that he uttered
in his January 1961 farewell address, warning against the influence of the
military-industrial complex, however, while in office, Eisenhower unleashed
CIA coups against democratically elected governments.

As most _CounterPunch_ readers know, Eisenhower approved the coup in Iran in
which the democratically elected Mohammad Mosaddegh was removed from power and
replaced by the Shah. In 1953, Eisenhower gave presidential approval for
Operation Ajax, the very first CIA coup. That coup led to the dictatorship by
the Shah, which ultimately led to the 1979 Iranian revolution, followed by an
oppressive theocracy. All this suffering can be traced back to the CIA coup
which Eisenhower approved.

Eisenhower also approved of the first CIA coup in Latin America in Guatemala
in 1954 (the U.S. had intervened in Latin America many times before 1954, but
those earlier interventions were not CIA-orchestrated coups). Similar to
Mosaddegh, the democratically elected Jacobo Arbenz wanted Guatemalans rather
than foreign corporations to benefit from their own country’s wealth, and
Eisenhower ordered the CIA to overthrow Arbenz. And then in 1959, before he
left office, Eisenhower approved the CIA plan to invade Cuba. Thanks to
Eisenhower, CIA coups against democratically elected governments around the
world that were unfriendly to U.S. corporations were normalized in U.S.
foreign policy.

Now compare Eisenhower’s sins to those of Noam Chomsky.

The facts tell us that Chomsky had a stupid and embarrassing friendship with
sexual predator Jeffrey Epstein. However, neither AWTT nor even Chomsky’s
harshest critics such as Chris Hedges accuse Chomsky of himself being a sexual
predator.

As I note in the [earlier _CounterPunch_
article](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/04/10/malcolm-x-noam-chomsky-
sexual-predator-associations-and-legacy-twists/), just as Malcolm X’s
biographer Manning Marable tells us that Malcolm X _should_ have known that
Elijah Muhammad, the leader of the Nation of Islam—who the African American
Historical Society [reports](https://www.aaihs.org/the-complexities-and-
contradictions-of-the-nation-of-islam/) “impregnated seven women, including
several of his teenaged secretaries, and fathered thirteen children outside of
his marriage”—was a sexual predator and a monster, Noam Chomsky _should_ have
known that Jeffrey Epstein was a sexual predator and a monster. However, in
contrast to what Marable and many of us conclude about Malcolm X—who I am
happy to see AWTT also celebrates as a truth teller—Chris Hedges
[concludes](https://chrishedges.substack.com/p/noam-chomsky-jeffrey-epstein-
and) that Chomsky not only should have known the truth of Epstein, but he did
know and “he did not care”; however, this is speculation, not fact, about
Chomsky’s state of mind.

Hedges himself is celebrated in the AWTT portrait gallery, despite the fact
that in the _New Republic_ in 2014, journalist Christopher Ketcham
[documents](https://newrepublic.com/article/118114/chris-hedges-pulitzer-
winner-lefty-hero-plagiarist) Hedges’s plagiarism (“The Troubling Case of
Chris Hedges: Pulitzer Winner. Lefty Hero. Plagiarist.”). Five days after this
exposé was published, the _New Republic_ published [Hedges’s response to
Ketcham’s charges](https://newrepublic.com/article/118212/chris-hedges-
responds-accusations-plagiarism), which were followed by Ketcham’s and the
_New Republic’s_ disputations of Hedges’s response. As far as I know, none of
the parties have filed libel suits; however, from this exchange, if I were on
the jury, I would find Hedges not only guilty of plagiarism but dishonest in
his attacks on Ketcham and the _New Republic_.

AWTT also celebrates Muhammad Ali—whom I greatly admire as a truth teller.
However, worse than Chomsky, Ali maintained his relationship with sexual
predator Elijah Muhammad after the ugly realities of Elijah Muhammad were
publicly exposed by Malcolm X; and then Ali abandoned his friend Malcolm X
after Malcolm X was driven out of the Nation of Islam, an abandonment for
which Ali ultimately stated he regretted.

Given the AWTT’s rationale for the cancellation of Chomsky, it is also curious
that it celebrates Mark Twain who had, as Linda Simon in the _Paris Review_
[described](https://www.theparisreview.org/blog/2017/11/28/mark-twains-
disturbing-passion-for-collecting-young-girls/) in 2017, a “disturbing passion
for collecting young girls”—age ten to sixteen whom Twain called his
“angelfish.” This passion is further detailed in Ron Chernow’s 2025 biography
of Twain in which Chernow concludes, “Twain pursued teenage girls with a
strange passion that, while it always remained chaste, is likely to cause
extreme discomfort nowadays. . . . What made the angelfish obsession so
disturbing was the strange intensity of his involvement with the girls.”

Neither Malcolm X, Muhammad Ali, Mark Twain, nor Noam Chomsky have been
accused of being sexual predators, and they, along with Chris Hedges, can all
be celebrated as “truth tellers” in many areas. However, all are personally
flawed, as are damn near all human beings; as all human beings have emotional
and ego needs that can result in embarrassing errors in judgment.

Why does the cancellation criteria of AWTT—and much of the Left—trouble me? I
have seen how the criteria of a specific type of personal failing that is
inconsistently applied while ignoring horrific policies and actions—as in the
case of Eisenhower—has diminished the number of Left activists. I’ve talked
with many young people who greatly value social and economic justice but tell
me that they avoid public life and activism rather than subjecting themselves
to Left cancellation humiliation for a poor judgment in their personal life.
In simplest terms, they are reluctant to join a team that is so unforgiving
for personal failings and which is inconsistently and unfairly punitive. The
resulting shrinking Left activism has been useful for the Right,
authoritarianism, and Trump insanity, which have been met by relatively weak
resistance. And so an already unjust and dehumanized society has grown
increasingly more so.
